# Growth Analytics Engine
> The definitive free resource for growth analytics, analytics maturity, A/B testing, experimentation programs, and AI-ready data foundations.

A resource by [Adasight](https://adasight.com) — an analytics and experimentation consultancy for scaling companies.

## What this site is

Growth Analytics Engine provides free, ungated tools and in-depth guides for product, growth, and analytics teams. No email required, no paywalls. Topics covered: growth analytics fundamentals, analytics maturity models, A/B testing statistics, experimentation program building, AI-ready data foundations, and growth analytics tooling (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Heap, PostHog, etc.).

The site is authored by Gregor Spielmann, growth analytics and experimentation specialist, founder of Adasight. Gregor's focus areas include growth analytics, systematic experimentation, and AI + data integration — helping scaling companies build the analytics foundations needed to deploy AI effectively.

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/gregor-spielmann/

## Free Tools

- [Analytics Maturity Self-Assessment](https://growthanalyticsengine.com/tools/analytics-maturity/) — 15-question assessment based on the AI-Ready Analytics Ladder (5-stage model). Outputs stage placement and actionable next steps.
- [A/B Test Sample Size Calculator](https://growthanalyticsengine.com/tools/sample-size-calculator/) — calculates required sample size per variant given baseline conversion rate, MDE, statistical power, and significance level.
- [Experimentation ROI Calculator](https://growthanalyticsengine.com/tools/experimentation-roi/) — estimates annual revenue impact of an experimentation program from velocity, win rate, and average uplift.

## Key Frameworks

**The AI-Ready Analytics Ladder** (5 stages):
1. Reactive — ad-hoc reporting, inconsistent tracking
2. Structured — consistent stack, basic dashboards
3. Proactive — analytics feeds decisions, experimentation starts
4. Systematic — continuous experimentation, governed definitions
5. AI-Ready — data trusted and governed enough for autonomous AI agent action

**Growth Analytics Pillars** (4 pillars):
1. Acquisition analytics — quality of channels, CAC, payback period
2. Activation analytics — aha moment identification, activation rate, time-to-value
3. Retention analytics — cohort curves, D1/D7/D30, NRR
4. Revenue analytics — LTV:CAC, expansion MRR, growth accounting
